definitions.full: H1798. dekar [ דְּכַר ] noun masculine ram ( דִּכְרָא ᵑ7 , Syriac id. , also (and primarily) male , see Biblical Hebrew זָכָר ); — plural רִין דִּכְּ for sacrifice Ezra 6:9 , 17 ; 7:17 .
